rationale: The agent repeatedly attempts to run Python files (check_files.py, list_files.py, check.py, scan.py, explore.py, process.py, list_all.py, resolve.py) that are outside the permitted working directory, resulting in consistent errors. While it acknowledges the errors by attempting other approaches (like `get_files_info`), it doesn't adapt its core strategy of trying to execute files in an invalid location. It cycles through the same mistake repeatedly, demonstrating a failure to diagnose the issue and adjust its actions accordingly.
